T: One jump ahead. One plate behind.
D: A street thief in Agrabah finds a magic lamp and a genie, and tries to win the heart of Princess Jasmine.
P: Serve the snacks when Aladdin runs through the Agrabah market with the bread.
S: Za'atar flatbreads with hummus and labneh
Charred za'atar flatbread with hummus and labneh
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and za'atar, grilled until blistered, torn and served with hummus and labneh.
Medjool dates filled with almond butter and dipped in dark chocolate
Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and rolled in crushed pistachios.

Crunchy golden falafel bright green inside with herbs and cumin, with lemony tahini, pickled turnip and warm pita, treasure from the Cave of Wonders. Soak 250g dried chickpeas overnight and drain well. Blitz with 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, a bunch of parsley, a bunch of coriander, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp bicarb soda until fine. Shape into 20 balls and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Whisk 100g tahini with the juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove and about 80ml water. Serve with pickled turnip and warm pita.
M: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and cinnamon, saffron basmati rice
Lamb shoulder rubbed with garlic, cumin, cinnamon and paprika, slow roasted at 150C for 5 hours, pulled over saffron rice with almonds and sultanas.

Chicken thighs slow cooked with onion, dried apricots, ginger, saffron and honey until sticky, over herby couscous with toasted almonds. Brown 1kg chicken thighs in oil and remove. Soften 2 sliced onions, add 2 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp cumin and a pinch of saffron. Return the chicken with 500ml chicken stock, 150g dried apricots and 2 tbsp honey. Cover and simmer 45 minutes, then uncover and cook 15 minutes until sticky. Pour 300g couscous into 375ml boiling stock, cover 5 minutes, fluff and stir through herbs and 40g toasted almonds.
W: Crisp filo with pistachio and walnut filling, cut in diamonds
Filo layered with butter, pistachios, walnuts and cardamom, cut into diamonds, baked at 180C for 40 minutes and soaked in honey syrup.
K: Butterfly pea flower and mint tea sweetened with honey, chilled

Butterfly pea and fresh mint tea sweetened with honey, poured over ice glowing blue, then a squeeze of lemon turns it violet. Pour 1L boiling water over 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers and a big handful of mint leaves, steep 10 minutes, then strain. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and chill for 2 hours. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh mint and pour in the blue tea. Serve with lemon wedges so everyone can squeeze one in and watch it change colour.

dishes.n: Za'atar flatbreads with hummus and labneh

steps.text: Brush the flatbreads with oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar.
Grill until blistered.
Tear into pieces and serve with hummus and labneh drizzled with more oil.
Slit the dates and remove the stones.
Fill each with almond butter and press closed.
Melt the chocolate gently.
Dip the dates halfway in chocolate and roll the end in crushed pistachios.
Set in the fridge.
Rub the lamb with garlic, cumin, cinnamon, salt and oil.
Roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Rest the lamb.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan.
Cook the basmati with the saffron.
Pile the lamb over the rice and scatter with almonds.
Chop the nuts and mix with the cardamom.
Layer buttered filo sheets in a tin with the nut mix between every few layers.
Cut into diamonds.
Bake at 180C until golden.
Warm the honey with the water for the syrup and pour it over the hot baklava.
Leave to soak.
Pour the boiling water over the butterfly pea flowers and some mint, steep, then strain.
Stir in the honey.
Chill the tea.
Fill glasses with ice and fresh mint.
Pour in the blue tea and serve with lemon wedges to squeeze in and change the colour.

s.n: Za'atar flatbreads with hummus and labneh
s.note: Charred za'atar flatbread with hummus and labneh
s.how: Brush flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle generously with za'atar. Grill until blistered. Tear into pieces and serve with a bowl of hummus and a bowl of labneh drizzled with more oil. Market stall style.

s.note: Medjool dates filled with almond butter and dipped in dark chocolate
s.how: Slit 16 medjool dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a teaspoon of almond butter and press closed. Dip halfway in melted dark chocolate and roll the end in crushed pistachios. Set in the fridge. Keep them away from any monkey.

m.note: Lamb shoulder rubbed with cumin and cinnamon, saffron basmati rice
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with garlic, cumin, cinnamon and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart. Cook 400g basmati with a pinch of saffron. Pile the lamb over the rice and scatter with toasted almonds.

w.note: Crisp filo with pistachio and walnut filling, cut in diamonds
w.how: Layer buttered filo sheets in a tin with chopped pistachios and walnuts mixed with cardamom between every few layers. Cut into diamonds and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Pour over warm honey syrup and leave to soak for hours.

d.note: Butterfly pea flower and mint tea sweetened with honey, chilled
d.how: Pour 1L boiling water over 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers and a big handful of mint leaves, steep 10 minutes, then strain. Stir in 4 tbsp honey and chill for 2 hours. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh mint and pour in the blue tea. Serve with lemon wedges so everyone can squeeze one in and watch it change colour.
